children: Apparel chain Uniqlo is returning with a new flagship after leaving downtown San Francisco five years ago. "The 1.5-Million-Square-Foot Hole in the Center of San Francisco's Comeback," published at 5:30 a.m. on Sept. 8 incorrectly said the chain, which operates another outlet in the city, had left San Francisco.
